- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:215-222 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pip install command runs with `--quiet` but has no `--no-cache-dir`, no version pinning, and installs directly into the runner's system Python site-packages (no virtualenv or `--user` guard beyond what GitHub provides).
  WHY: A cached stale wheel, partial download, or future dependency conflict (jsonschema ecosystem moves fast) can cause the subsequent Unit tests (which import the real validator) to load the wrong/incompatible version, reproducing the exact desync that the original release failure exposed.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:211-223 and symmetric block in test-and-mark-stable.yml:3271-3283 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No retry wrapper or `|| true` fallback on the pip install. The step uses `set -euo pipefail` so any transient PyPI/network failure aborts the entire validate-scripts job.
  WHY: GitHub runners experience occasional PyPI blips (rate limits, transient 5xx, mirror lag). This would prevent the release gate from completing even when the underlying test bug is fixed, violating the intent of a robust CI gate.
